gaps.statement: A falsifiable cross-modal discrimination between spin-only and spin-times-coherent-spectral-weight explanations of the superconducting scale is missing.
gaps.rejection_condition: If jointly measured magnetic support and antinodal coherence do not improve prediction over the spin-only baseline under held-out material/doping conditions, reject the proposed coupling relation.

gaps.statement: Find the universal mechanism of all high-temperature superconductors.
gaps.reason: It conflates cuprates, pressure-stabilized hydrides, pnictides, and materials with different electronic structures.
